images.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Project asset: Aleria, the great trading post of Klingende Münze in Gwynthor. Portrait composition 2:3. Tales of Xillia/Frieren Anime Art Style. Clear anime lineart, clean cel shading, simple soft anime textures for timber and stone, no photorealism, no painterly rendering. A very large wealthy medieval Celtic harbor trading compound seen from its broad quay court at a slight elevation: connected pale sandstone counting houses, tall slate-roof timber warehouses, an elegant arcaded bank wing, a modest fortified red-company command wing, and beyond a shipbuilding slip with one wooden trading vessel. One coherent complex, lively working harbor yet calm readable composition. In foreground broad cobbled receiving court, a few barrels and neatly stacked crates; distant small ordinary human dock workers, no identifiable leaders, no elves. Red and muted gold banners, one simple golden coin-purse symbol on red over the central arch. Bay, masts and medieval Gwynthor skyline in background. Architecture consistent with prosperous northwestern medieval fantasy, no modern cranes, firearms, cars, industrial machinery, glass skyscrapers, text labels or logos. Blue sky, warm late morning light. Keep major architecture uncluttered and spacious, do not duplicate a single warehouse facade across the entire image.

Use case: illustration-story. Aleria story asset: council chamber of the Klingende Münze trading post in Gwynthor. Vertical 2:3 illustration. Tales of Xillia/Frieren Anime Art Style, clean anime lineart, clean cel shading, simple textures, no photorealism and no painterly rendering. A stately yet practical late medieval Celtic merchant council room overlooking a harbor through tall stone windows. One wide OCTAGONAL dark wooden table with exactly eight equal unoccupied chairs arranged around it. No throne, no chair larger or higher than the others, no ninth chair. A few closed account books, rolled sea charts and wax seals on the table, restrained red and muted gold decoration, a single small gold coin purse ornament above the door. Pale sandstone, slate-grey shadows, timber-beam ceiling, calm daylight with warm lantern accents. No people. No text, no labels, no modern furniture, no modern maps, no house crests invented. Frame the entire table and eight chairs clearly with generous floor space, eye level three-quarter view from doorway, balanced uncluttered composition. This is an equal eight-member merchant council, not a royal throne room.
